_meta.note: Seeded by CatalogSeeder. Adding a category here creates it; it never deletes one, because a category with products in it is not something a data file should be able to remove. Use the admin panel's on/off switch to hide a category instead — that hides its products too, reversibly. `image` must name a file that exists in assets/images/categories/ or be null: the admin renders a thumbnail when it is set and an 'Add an image' affordance when it is not, so a path to a missing file is the one value that produces a broken picture.
_meta.active: Mirrors the LIVE shop as of 6 August 2026. The database is the authority, not this file: CatalogSeeder sets is_active only when it CREATES a row, so a merchant's on/off decisions in the admin panel are never overwritten by a re-seed. That is deliberate — but it means this file drifts, and a drifted file will reproduce the wrong shop on a fresh install. Re-sync it from GET /api/catalog/categories after a merchandising change. The live set is: chocolates-dairy, dates-nuts, fashion-clothes, flash-sale, home-decor, kids-toys, kitchen-appliances, oil-ghee.
